class.name: FoundryBuildContext
class.brief_description: Runtime context passed to a script-backed Foundry build task.
class.description: Carries the task identity, provider identity, project configuration path, and task options used when invoking [method FoundryBuildTask.run]. Build-task discovery can instantiate providers without constructing this context.

members.member: The provider-specific options configured for the task.
The project configuration path associated with this build invocation.
The id of the provider handling the task.
